notes.subject: אמר
notes.rationale: The noun אֹמֶר (utterance) occurs only here in the Tanakh; rendered plain kuma.

notes.subject: המבשרות
notes.rationale: Feminine plural 'the women who announce'; geneva/kjv lose the gender, ylt/jps keep it — musolaselimɔgɔw keeps the women proclaimers.

notes.subject: צבאאדני
notes.rationale: 'Adonay gives the word — a great host (צבא) of heralds': army-word used of women proclaimers, echoing Yawe-Sebaot.

translation: Adonay ye kuma di; musolaselimɔgɔw dabada ye.
